description:
In lovely Broomstown, many cars with various jobs such as school buses, taxis, heavy equipment, tow trucks, cleaning cars, and mail delivery cars all live together. Large and small accidents occur every day in Broomstown, just like any other town. However, don't worry. The transforming rescue team is here to save any friends in distress anytime, anywhere!

The courageous and swift police car POLI, the powerful fire engine ROY, the intelligent AMBER, and the flying HELLY are all here to save the day!

(Source: Official Website)
